display_long_description:
# From the team who brought you Alcove, welcome to your Sanctuary. 

With experiences designed to connect you to the world and pique your curiosity, embedded in a new space with fresh ways to make it your own - we hope Sanctuary will become your home away from home. 

* Customize your sanctuary with shared photos, uploaded videos - and now, generative AI features to create art and sculpt new furnishings.
* Travel the world, from iconic landmarks to your own childhood neighborhood. 
* Relax and practice meditation in nature - guided, or unguided.
* Listen to classical music.

...plus, you'll have access to your own friendly companion along the way.

# Meet Nova! 

Nova brings a whole new level of creativity and interaction to Alcove. You can have a conversation with Nova in real-time to generate stunning images, craft custom 3D models, search for experiences, explore the world, or simply connect and chat.

**All of this and more is available with a Sanctuary+ subscription.**

We can't wait to see what you come up with.
